Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your proposal. Your comprehensive product range offers a sound basis for consolidating the fastener kit, and we agree that dependable service matters for keeping production running smoothly.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).

Based on our analysis, the proposed bundle prices reflect the opportunity to consolidate recurring demand with a longer commitment. We are flexible on payment terms, including an option retaining your quoted terms; which package works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.85 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.79 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.80 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We look forward to agreeing a practical contract amendment with you that also makes delivery recovery explicit.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
